$comment: PROJECT settings for TR4W/TR4W-D12. TRACKED, and it must stay that way.
These are the repository's own guardrails and they belong to the repository,
not to whoever happens to have cloned it. Until 2026-08-29 they lived in
settings.local.json, which is gitignored -- so every one of them was real on
one machine and absent on the next, and CLAUDE.md described a settings.json
that did not exist. Anything personal or machine-specific goes in
settings.local.json instead; it is ignored and it wins over this file.
PATHS USE $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, NEVER AN ABSOLUTE PATH. The clones are not at
the same place -- C:\tr4w-d12 here, C:\projects\TR4W-D12 elsewhere -- and a
hardcoded path is a hook that silently does not run in the other clone.
